## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials are both negative (Financials 1W: -2.01%; Industrials 1W: -2.78%), while defensives/consumer staples (EL, TGT, JNJ) are outperforming — signaling defensive positioning despite mixed breadth.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND. Energy also firm: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lag with LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND and HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Materials & Healthcare dominate Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION, TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Highest 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40%), FCX (1W: +15.30%), MRK (1W: +12.30%); all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: multiple megacaps show 1W vs 1M mismatch (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, JPM) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE, so treat regime signals cautiously and watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and under short-term pressure: AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 9/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft and corrective: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND — breadth uneven with notable names correcting. Sector breadth: Financials: 8/20 positive (internal rotation).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive strength: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 12/17 positive (Sector Strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive and cyclical/ value names (consumer staples, healthcare, select energy/materials) and reduce exposure to volatile large-cap tech names showing short-term weakness. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials/Energy/Staples leadership and Financials/Industrials weakness; monitor megacap divergences before expanding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Sector breadth: 12/17 positive) and Energy (Sector breadth: 7/10 positive) for continued defensive/cyclical strength. BEARISH: Utilities (Sector breadth: 2/10 positive) and Industrials (Sector breadth: 4/15 positive) as weakness may persist.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch AAPL 1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74% (RECOVERY) holding near recent support for a confirmed bounce; NVDA 1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85% (CORRECTION) — failure to reclaim short-term pivot risks further downside; JPM 1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48% (CORRECTION) — watch for stabilization above monthly pivot to resume leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (+80): Largest-ever buyback headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) — sentiment confirming short-term strength. LLY (+60): GLP‑1 advances/UK clearance; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) — sentiment confirmed. DE (+75): Guided higher; price showing strength in Industrials but sector mixed — follow-through required.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-80): Recall headline but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +13.50%) — clear divergence (bearish news, price rising). INTC (-50): Stock-sale headline and price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) — sentiment confirmed. UNH (-50): IRS tax scrutiny and price BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -7.90%) — confirming risk to sector leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Value/Cyclical tilt given defensive Consumer Staples and Healthcare leadership; Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. EL, FCX, MRK are showing clear strength (all ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major megacap divergence (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN showing mixed 1W vs 1M) and notable news/price divergences (TSLA) — watch for trend confirmation.
